subject.title: [Bug]: childless codex-native subagent stuck initializing can exhaust unified exec capacity

question: Should childless Codex-native subagents stuck in initializing be surfaced early as diagnostics, state-queried against Codex, or automatically marked terminal before the current 30-minute grace?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects live native subagents and could trade capacity recovery against false terminalization of valid quiet work.

options.title: Warn and state-query first
options.body: Add a 5-10 minute status/audit warning and prefer Codex thread-state or transcript reconciliation before marking the task lost.

options.title: Shorten terminalization
options.body: Reduce the automatic lost/cancelled threshold for initializing childless Codex-native rows and require live proof that legitimate long-running subagents are not falsely ended.

options.title: Split diagnostics from recovery
options.body: Track Codex app-server version display and gateway forced restart separately while keeping this issue scoped to task lifecycle recovery.

recommendation.title: Warn and state-query first
recommendation.body: Add a 5-10 minute status/audit warning and prefer Codex thread-state or transcript reconciliation before marking the task lost.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent comments and merged work show direct context on the Codex-native recovery policy and blocked-spawn task lifecycle behavior.
